title: Existing arbitrary jointly-surjective inverse-image conservativity
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and let $a_i:U_i\to X$ be a small jointly surjective family of arbitrary scheme morphisms. For etale $A$-module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], a morphism is an isomorphism if all its inverse images [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] by the $a_i$ are isomorphisms. The morphisms are not assumed etale. This is the ModuleCat specialization of the existing source theorem for concrete coefficient categories.

proof.text: For each point x of X, choose a preimage y in some U_i and the algebraic-closure residue-field geometric point at y. These geometric points, composed with a_i, jointly cover X. The geometric fibre of a morphism after this composition is the fibre of its pullback along a_i, and is invertible by hypothesis. Conservativity of the resulting covering family of geometric points proves invertibility of the original sheaf morphism. The source proof implements this with the universe-raised geometric points and the jointly-reflecting family theorem, so it applies to ModuleCat in the required universe. If the family is empty, the covering hypothesis makes X empty and conservativity still applies.
